source.code:
/-- Code for partial recursive functions from ℕ to ℕ.
See `Nat.Partrec.Code.eval` for the interpretation of these constructors.
-/
inductive Code : Type
  | zero : Code
  | succ : Code
  | left : Code
  | right : Code
  | pair : Code → Code → Code
  | comp : Code → Code → Code
  | prec : Code → Code → Code
  | rfind' : Code → Code
